## Install

### Linux

**Flatpak (recommended, updates automatically):**

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumige https://flatpak.tsumige.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumige app.tsumige.Tsumige
```

**AppImage:** download `Tsumige-…-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### macOS

Download `Tsumige-…-macos.zip` and unzip it. The app is not signed, so the first launch is blocked: right-click it, choose **Open**, then confirm.

### Windows

Download `Tsumige-…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumige.exe`.

[Full documentation](https://github.com/aaronbamblett/tsumige#readme)
